body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids label-the-parts printable: Parts of Nature 08.
A diagram to label using the word bank — read each word, find the part it names, and write it in the matching box.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, read the word bank together first, then let your scientist hunt for each part and write its name. Checking against a real object afterwards makes it stick.

takeaway: Naming the parts of a thing is the first step of science — you cannot investigate what you cannot name.
materials: The real thing to look at afterwards, if you can find one
supervision: Read the word bank aloud together before starting — sounding out the science words is half the learning.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Go and find the real thing — a flower, a leaf, a bicycle — and point to each part you labelled, in real life.
